steps.what: Ask which compliance point needs advice
Pull the applicable codes and standards
Draft advice on those regulations

loop.output: advice that cites policy version ids
loop.check: Every cited id is on the extract
loop.stop: Drop a sentence with no policy id and stop after one draft
loop.why_not_simpler: What this store should do is not a sentence in the policy

steps.what: Advise retail managers on the compliance point
Sign the advice given to those managers
File the signed compliance advice

tasks.design: A retail manager asks about a compliance point. The loss prevention manager pulls the applicable codes and standards from {DOCS} and drafts advice that may cite only those rows. The manager advises the retail managers in a conversation and signs the advice that was given. The advice does not decide a case about a person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice lived in mail with no policy version, so a store could follow a rule that had been replaced.
tasks.enabler_now: A policy row can carry a version, a code and a standard that the advice can cite.
tasks.still_hard: What the store should do this week is still a conversation, and a gap in the policy is not filled by a draft.
tasks.human_edge: The manager advises the retail managers and signs the only advice they should follow.

ambition.what: Sign compliance advice when the code is named, not at the next regional meeting

tasks.altitude: Less time hunting the old policy. The advice itself stays with the manager.

evidence.claim: Compliance advice in a retail chain is a policy version plus a conversation with the store. The library is not the advice.
Digest [S1] describes a versioned policy library that classifies regulatory text and flags gaps. A person still approves. This advice cites a version and does not decide a case.

Digest [S15] says a compliance review partly drafted by a model cited sources that were not real, and the firm repaid the last instalment. Advice here is checked against the policy row before it is signed.
Digest [S9] says a decision about a person must not rest on automation alone. This advice is about a code or a standard. It does not sanction anyone.

assumptions: Focal role is the loss prevention manager. The retail manager asks and then applies the advice in the store.
Input contract: store id, question, policy id if known. Producer is the retail manager. A question with no store id is answered by hand and marked manual.
Use the document store's policy rows before a custom library.
unknowns: Which codes the firm has already mapped to a policy version.
research_questions: How often does the signed advice cite a different version than the draft?

already_counted.description: The advice conversation stays with the manager
Checking the draft against the policy stays

incremental.description: Retire a policy row when the code it cites is withdrawn

approvals.approved_version: advice signed for this store and policy version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes policy rows have no version, so the draft is discarded and the conversation stays as it is. The high case saves the lookup only. The advice conversation and the sign-off are not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List community agencies in current partnerships
Draft the note for the enforcement meeting

loop.input: the last signed note and the new subject
loop.output: a draft that names agency and date only
loop.check: The agency is on the contact list
loop.stop: Stop if the draft names a person as a suspect
loop.why_not_simpler: What the agency will agree is not known before the meeting

steps.what: Meet the enforcement agencies in person
State what those agencies can share
Maintain partnerships with the enforcement agencies

tasks.design: The loss prevention manager keeps partnerships with enforcement agencies and with the retail loss prevention community. A note in {DOCS} records who was met and what was agreed. The meeting itself stays in person. The note does not become a list of named suspects, and nothing is shared onward unless the manager signs it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Partnership notes were private mail, so a colleague could not see which agency had been met.
tasks.enabler_now: A contact row can hold an agency, a date and a note version.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, and what an agency is willing to share, is a relationship. It does not move to a form.
tasks.human_edge: The manager meets the agencies and decides what the partnership note may say.
tasks.altitude: The meeting stays the work. The note is shorter to file after the manager has signed it.

reach.task: Meet on the agreed subject only
reach.learn: Which note version is the current agreement

evidence.claim: A partnership with an enforcement agency is a meeting and a short note. A contact database does not create the relationship.
Digest [S9] says a decision about a person must not rest on automation alone. Sharing a named file is a decision the manager signs. The partnership note is not that decision.
Digest [S15] says generated text has cited sources that were not real. A draft partnership note is checked against what was actually said before it is signed.

assumptions: Focal role is the loss prevention manager. Agency time is not this role's saving.

Input contract: agency name, meeting date, subject, what was agreed. Producer is the manager after the meeting. A note that names a suspect is refused and handled as a case, not as a partnership record.
This task does not watch staff. Works-council consent is a separate decision if a later design does.
unknowns: Which agencies will meet, and how often.
research_questions: What share of meetings produce no note the manager is willing to sign?

already_counted.description: The meeting stays with the manager
Deciding what the note may say stays

incremental.description: Drop an agency that has not met for a year

approvals.approved_version: partnership note signed for this agency and date

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes meetings are rare and notes stay in mail, so little is filed. The high case files a signed note after each meeting. The meeting itself is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open shrink results outside acceptable ranges
Direct the inventory investigations for that shrink
Count the inventory lines the manager named
Sign the result of those investigations
File the signed shrink investigation

tasks.design: A shrink result on {ERP} that sits outside the acceptable range opens a queue. The loss prevention manager directs the inventory investigations for that shrink. Store staff count the lines named. The manager signs the result. The queue is stock figures. A finding that names a person is a separate signed case, not an automatic outcome of the range.
tasks.previous_blocker: Shrink exceptions arrived as a monthly pack, so an investigation started late and without a named range.
tasks.enabler_now: The stock export can flag a result against a stored acceptable range.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the count explains the shrink, and whether a person is involved, stays a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager directs the investigation and signs the result.

ambition.what: Open an investigation when the range is breached, not in the monthly pack

tasks.altitude: The queue is faster to open. Directing the count and signing the result stay with the manager.

reach.task: Count only the lines the manager named

evidence.claim: A shrink investigation is a stock figure, a count, and a person who decides what the difference means.
Digest [S2] describes a governance register for incidents and controls. Here it is a queue of shrink rows, not a watch of the shop floor or of named staff.
Digest [S8] says one hospital's incident register grew from 125 reports to tens of thousands. That is more reporting, not less harm, so a fuller shrink queue is not counted as less loss.
Digest [S9] says a decision about a person must not rest on automation alone. A stock range does not name anyone. A finding that does is signed by the manager.

assumptions: Focal role is the loss prevention manager. The store count is other people's time.
Input contract: store id, period, shrink amount, acceptable range, line ids. Producer is the stock export. A row with no range is not queued.
Use the stock system's own exception query before custom code. This is not covert surveillance.
unknowns: Who set the acceptable range, and when it was last reviewed.
research_questions: What share of out-of-range rows are explained by a count error?

already_counted.description: Directing the investigation stays with the manager

incremental.description: Review the acceptable range when a season changes the stock mix

approvals.approved_version: investigation result signed for this shrink id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes ranges are missing, so the queue rarely opens and every count stays as it is. The high case opens the queue from the export, but directing the investigation and signing the result are not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather rows of this week's activity
Draft documentation from those activity rows

loop.input: activity rows and the note template
loop.output: a note that cites row ids only
loop.check: Every sentence cites a row id on the extract
loop.stop: Drop a sentence with no row id and stop after one draft
loop.why_not_simpler: A row does not say whether the activity worked

steps.what: Check the draft against the activity rows
Sign the documentation of that activity
Maintain documentation by filing the signed note

tasks.design: Each day's loss prevention activity is a row: store, time, what was done. A draft in {DOCS} may only restate those rows. The manager checks the draft against the rows, signs the documentation, and the signed note is filed. A fuller file is not evidence that loss fell.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activity was written up at the end of the week from memory, so the record and the week could disagree.
tasks.enabler_now: An activity row can be stored as it happens and cited by id.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the row is complete, and whether it may be filed, is still the manager's check.
tasks.human_edge: The manager maintains the documentation by signing only what the rows support.

ambition.what: Sign the day's activity record the same day, not in a Friday reconstruction

tasks.altitude: Less time reconstructing the week. The check that the record is true stays with the manager.

reach.task: Read the signed activity note for that store

evidence.claim: Activity documentation is a row per action and a person who checks the write-up. The file does not reduce loss by existing.
Digest [S8] says one register grew from 125 reports to tens of thousands. More documentation is not less loss, so this filing is not counted as prevention.
Digest [S15] says generated text has cited sources that were not real. The draft is checked against the activity rows before it is signed.

assumptions: Focal role is the loss prevention manager. The task ends when the signed note is filed.
Input contract: store id, date, activity type, short fact. Producer is the person who did the activity. A row with no store or date is not drafted.
Use the document store's template before custom code.
unknowns: Which activity types the stores actually record.
research_questions: What share of drafts add a sentence that no row supports?

already_counted.description: Checking the draft against the rows stays

incremental.description: Add an activity type when stores start a new kind of check

approvals.approved_version: documentation signed for these activity row ids

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes rows are missing, so the manager still writes the week from memory. The high case drafts from complete rows, but every note is still checked and signed. The existence of the file is not treated as loss avoided.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager stops retyping compliance notes, partnership logs and activity sheets, and spends the week on the advice, the agency meeting and the shrink that is actually out of range.
reach: Retail managers receive signed advice tied to a policy version.
Store supervisors receive a named shrink investigation instead of a vague alarm.
skills_to_grow: Cite the policy version when advising on a code or a standard.
Keep a partnership as a meeting and a note, not as a feed of people.
Treat a shrink figure as stock, and sign any finding that names a person.
role.ambitious_version: Each week has signed compliance advice, a current partnership note, a closed shrink investigation and one activity record checked against its rows.
